generation_reason: V1 immediate-entry failed net of costs. V1 post-hoc diagnostics suggested SHORT gross edge survives only in stronger moves; V2 changes entry mechanism only, testing a causal pullback/retest limit entry. This is a new EXPLORATORY generation.

data.validation_period: 2025-2026 is SEEN validation and must not be read by this TRAIN run
data.universe: all symbols in frozen source artifacts
data.point_in_time_universe_status: unknown; survivorship/listing eligibility must be audited before VALIDATED_CANDIDATE

signal.why_short_only: Chosen after V1; therefore post-hoc relative to V1 and explicitly a new exploratory generation.
signal.compression: ATR16/ATR96 <= 0.65 using values available before signal bar
signal.first_breakout_guard: previous close inside its own prior-16-bar box
signal.breakout: signal bar close < prior box low
signal.order_live: next 15m bar open after signal close

retest_entry.crossed_at_bar_open: if bar open >= sell limit, fill immediately at bar open as taker; otherwise resting sell limit fills when high reaches the limit
retest_entry.maker_fill_bar_chronology: use canonical official Binance 1m resolver when fill-bar TP/SL chronology is ambiguous; same-1m exit after maker fill is conservative loss

exits.time_exit_convention: V1-compatible: if no TP/SL, use close of final allowed 15m bar at the 32-bar horizon; recorded timestamp is that bar's open_time

costs.separate_slippage: not modeled beyond all-in cost stress

portfolio.priority: entry_time ascending; expansion_strength descending; compression_strength descending; symbol ascending

gates: at least 3 of 4 calendar years have positive 20bp return
at least one adjacent grid configuration has PF20 > 1.03 and positive 20bp account return
selection.primary_ranking: highest 20bp account return among passing configs; tie lower MDD20, then higher PF40, then more executable trades
selection.next_if_pass: freeze TRAIN-selected stable region before opening 2025-2026 validation
selection.next_if_fail: preserve V2 as failed and move to another entry/exit mechanism; do not mine validation

execution.collision_policy: official Binance 1m; same 1m ambiguous => LOSS; data gaps/mismatches excluded
execution.required_smoke: psar_chronology_smoke.py plus V2-specific sell-limit entry smoke cases
